description: Create a supplier bill (expense) in Billy with one or more lines coded to expense accounts. Created as draft by default; pass state=approved to book it immediately.

currencyId.description: Bill currency, e.g. 'DKK' (defaults to org base currency)

accountId.description: Expense account ID to code the cost to (see list_accounts)

amount.description: Line amount in the bill currency

taxRateId.description: Tax rate ID for the line (when omitted, Billy typically defaults from the account settings)

taxMode.description: Whether amounts include or exclude VAT (defaults to org setting)

verbose.description: Return the full Billy response. Default false: compact records with key fields only (saves ~90% context)

name: create_bill
